items.t: Dual-clutch transmission shudder and jerky low-speed driving
items.job: Transmission fluid and filter service with adaptation reset (clutch pack or mechatronic unit if needed)
items.note: A fluid service is at the low end; clutch or mechatronic replacement is at the high end. Reported totals run $1,500 to $7,000, and more on AMG cars.
Owners report an average of about $1,300 total.

items.t: Timing chain rattle on cold start
items.job: Replace timing chain, tensioner and guides

items.note: AMG turbo replacement is reported around $6,500 total.

items.job: Add steering column grounding under recall
items.note: A broken clockspring is not covered by the recall and is a separate paid repair.

items.job: Starter current limiter repair under recall

items.t: Front roof panel can come loose after a repair (recall)
items.job: Replace front roof panel under recall
Camera and multimedia software update under recall
Communication module software update under recall

items.t: Coolant line leak and coolant warning
items.job: Replace leaking coolant line and refill coolant
items.note: May be covered free under a Mercedes service campaign; ask a dealer with your VIN.

items.t: Car won't unlock or start with 'Battery - Start Engine' message
items.job: Battery test, software update and battery replacement if needed

items.t: Creaking or grinding from steering column
items.job: Lubricate or replace steering column parts per bulletin
Service or replace front brake pads per bulletin

items.t: Chirping or tapping from engine pulley when cold
items.job: Diagnose and repair crankshaft pulley noise per bulletin

items.t: Driver door lock switch can corrode, risking rollaway (recall)
items.job: Replace driver door lock under recall

items.t: Rear brake caliper bolts may be loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and tighten rear caliper fasteners under recall

items.t: Missing rear brake pad wear gauge (recall)
items.job: Supply rear brake pad inspection gauge under recall
